report.name: lvl0_profiled_time
report.text: Application profile is long enough (60.31 s)
report.desc: To have good quality measurements, it is advised that the application profiling time is greater than 10 seconds.

report.name: lvl0_source_debug
report.text: Most of time spent in analyzed modules comes from functions with source/debug info
report.desc: -g option gives access to debugging informations, such are source locations.

report.name: lvl0_utilitary_options
report.text: Most of time spent in analyzed modules comes from functions with compilation options informations but -fno-omit-frame-pointer is missing
report.desc: -fno-omit-frame-pointer improves the accuracy of callchains found during the application profiling.

report.name: lvl0_is_perf_event_paranoid
report.text: Host configuration allows retrieval of all necessary metrics.

report.name: lvl0_architecture_options
report.text: Compilation of some functions is not optimized for the target processor
report.desc: -march=x86-64 option is used but it is not specific enough to produce efficient code.

report.name: lvl0_optimization_level
report.text: Optimization level option is correctly used

report.name: lvl0_profiled_modules
report.text: Application is correctly profiled ("Others" category represents 0.11 % of the execution time)
report.desc: To have a representative profiling, it is advised that the category "Others" represents less than 20% of the execution time in order to analyze as much as possible of the user code

report.name: lvl0_is_lstopo
report.text: Lstopo present. The Topology lstopo report will be generated.

report.name: lvl0_is_fastmath
report.desc: Consider to add ffast-math to compilation flags (or replace -O3 with -Ofast) to unlock potential extra speedup by relaxing floating-point computation consistency. Warning: floating-point accuracy may be reduced and the compliance to IEEE/ISO rules/specifications for math functions will be relaxed, typically 'errno' will no longer be set after calling some math functions.
